summary: Added a regression test for round-tripping a near-limit display spec with a full-length input response, then ran the full validation pipeline (prettier write+check, protocol vitest with 24 tests passing, type checks for protocol and agent-server) to verify the display implementation.
decisions: Round-trip test for a near-limit spec with a full-length input response was added before the existing 'returns a detached validated spec' test, to guard against large-envelope regressions.
